description: Your iOS listing in every App Store storefront: where the app is sold, which storefronts serve the fallback text or the fallback screenshots instead of their own language, and the second locale each storefront also indexes. Returns the last scan; `refresh: true` starts a new one when the last is older than 12 hours and answers 202 with `eta` seconds — call again after that. The full table is on Pro and above; Free gets the preview.

refresh.description: start a new scan when the last one is older than 12 hours

name: get_storefront_audit
